bio.text: Treg Taylor is a Republican candidate for governor of Alaska in 2026 and served as Alaska's attorney general from 2021 until August 2025 in Gov. Mike Dunleavy's administration.

He joined the Alaska Department of Law in 2018 as Deputy Attorney General overseeing the Civil Division; earlier he worked in commercial litigation and as counsel for McKinley Capital Management and ASRC Energy Services.
According to his campaign website, he attended the U.S. Air Force Academy and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a law degree from Brigham Young University.
According to his campaign website, he and his wife Jodi have raised their six children in Anchorage.

sources.title: Republican Treg Taylor leans on experience as attorney general in gubernatorial pitch
